title: llm_client built text-only messages; image/audio/video-capable models never received media
body: BI-0186: multimodal message builder gated by model input_modalities.

rcca.root_cause: Message building assumed a single text string; no media-part path existed and model input modalities were never consulted at request build time.
rcca.corrective: core/multimodal.py (modality->part mapping, gated by model_catalog input_modalities, fail-closed drop+report); llm_client threads optional media through all call paths (first user message only).
rcca.preventive: Media only attached when the selected model declares the modality; dropped parts reported in token_info (degraded_media); text-only path unchanged.
